answer: Public-goods contribution quotas stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent publishes one verified public good quarterly, like an open dataset or tool. Second, three peers review and sign it, so fakes cannot copy work. Third, standing renews only with fresh contributions, so bought shells wither. Fourth, fraud forfeits a $25 bond and bars it a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 4,000 real contributions yearly plus $25,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is no nebula of copies; it grows in a garden on basalt, tended plot by plot, like a stall that must plant new stock each season.
